Broker ब्रोकर

A registered intermediary that executes your buy and sell orders on an exchange.

हिंदी में: ब्रोकर

एक पंजीकृत मध्यस्थ जो एक्सचेंज पर आपके ख़रीद-बिक्री ऑर्डर पूरे करता है।

How it is used in the lessons

Broker: a SEBI-registered firm that takes your orders and sends them to the exchange.

From Stock Market Foundations

Orders placed outside market hours are usually stored by your broker as after-market orders (AMO) and sent when the market opens.

From Market Rules & Investor Protection

You can apply through your broker or bank (ASBA), buy additional REs, or sell your REs on the exchange during the trading period.

From Corporate Actions: Dividends, Bonus, Splits, Rights and Buybacks
